description: Erection of outbuilding in rear garden
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans: Site location plan; S-001 Rev 01; (FCI-018-)P001-002; P002-001 Rev 01; P002-001.1 Rev 01; P002-002 Rev 01; P002-003 Rev 01; P002-004 Rev 01; P002-005 Rev 02; JLA Town and Country Planning Consultants Design and Access Statement (dated 02/09/2025); GHA Trees - Tree Survey and Arboricultural Impact Assessment (dated 21/07/2025 and ref: HA/DS/160321:25) and GHA Tree Constraints Plan (dated July 2025)

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes incidental to the residential use of the dwelling known as 17 Greville Place, London NW6 5JE

Reason:
To protect the amenity of adjoining occupiers and to ensure that the outbuilding hereby permitted does not become a self-contained dwelling separate from the original dwellinghouse known as 17 Greville Place in accordance with Policies H1, H6, A1 and A4 of the Camden Local Plan (2017).
Condition : 4 - Prior to the commencement of works on site, tree protection measures shall be installed and working practices adopted in accordance with the document entitled Tree Survey and Arboricultural Impact Assessment: 17 Greville Place, London NW6 5JE dated 21/07/2025 by GHA Trees ref. GHA/DS/160321:25.  All trees on the site, or parts of trees grow from adjoining sites, unless shown on the permitted drawings as being removed, shall be retained and protected from damage in accordance with BS5837:2012 and with the approved protection details. The development shall be monitored by the project arboriculturalist in accordance with the approved report.

Reason: To ensure that the development will not have an adverse effect on existing trees and in order to maintain the character and amenity of the area in accordance with the requirements of policies A2 and A3 of the Camden Local Plan.
